a surveillance programme for the early detection of HCC in cirrhotics is cost effective in countries with a high prevalence of HCC and in those where the resources are available to offer a high rate of curative treatment.

surveillance for HCC in patients with LC should be based on the availability of resources and the prevalence of the neoplasm in the population.
